+"""Generate the frozen collect_screws trajectory using robot actions only."""

+OUTPUT = Path('/app/output/trajectory.npz')

+
+def build_trajectory(s):
+    s.reset()
+    p = s.primitives()
+    quat = p['top_down_quat'](np.pi / 2)
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Pinch the screw's head just above the table, then lift clear.
+    p['move_ee']('right', [0.38293, -0.20781, 0.86], quat, settle=15)
+    p['set_gripper']('right', 0.045)
+    p['move_ee']('right', [0.38293, -0.20781, 0.765], quat,
+                 linear=5, settle=20)
+    p['close_gripper']('right', steps=40)
